style: A finished, polished game screen, designed by a top-tier game UI studio. The result must look like a real, buildable interface: a clear layout with aligned panels, consistent spacing, one type family, readable text, every element purposeful. Dark and cinematic, with atmosphere (smoke, floor light, depth) but never cluttered. No watermark, no caption, no credits.

moments.title: Vs friend
moments.prompt: Redesign the game screen in the reference image. Keep its CONTENT and purpose exactly: a 'Player vs Friend' draft on one phone - two benches (Player 1 on the left, 'on the clock'; Player 2 on the right), each with a 'Load a real team' link and five position rings PG SG SF PF C, a 'snake order' marker between them, a draft board of twelve player cards (name, year, position, two ratings and a small bar chart each), and one wide action bar at the bottom reading 'Player 1 - pick 5 more'. Change the DESIGN: this is now a wide desk layout that fills the whole 16:9 frame instead of a narrow phone column on black. The two benches become two facing locker-room doors or two facing courtside benches, left and right, each lit in its own colour (cool blue for Player 1, hot red for Player 2), with the five rings drawn as five empty jersey hooks under each. The draft board sits between them as a long table of cards seen from slightly above, the twelve cards laid in two rows of six like a card game, each card a small player tile with its name and ratings. Behind everything a dark gym at night: a hardwood floor reflecting the two coloured lights, haze, a far hoop. The action bar runs along the bottom edge like a scoreboard strip. Text must be real, legible English exactly as listed.

moments.title: 1v1 bid
moments.prompt: Redesign the game screen in the reference image. Keep its CONTENT and purpose exactly: a '1v1 Bid' auction - two chairs (Player 1 left, Player 2 right) each holding '$20' and '0/5 men' with five open rings PG SG SF PF C, an 'open outcry' marker between them, a central lot 'Lot 1 - on the block' showing one player card (Toni Kukoc '99, Point forward, O71 D61) with three small stat bars PLAY OUT REB, a line 'Player 1 holds the bid', and two big buttons at the bottom: 'Player 2 - bid $2' and 'Pass'. Change the DESIGN: this is now a wide desk layout filling the whole 16:9 frame instead of a tiny phone column on black. It is an AUCTION HOUSE at night: a dark wood-panelled room, a raised auctioneer's rostrum at the centre with the player card standing on it under one hot spotlight and a brass gavel beside it, a red velvet rope, the current bid '$1' glowing on a brass plate; the two bidders' chairs are two leather club chairs left and right, each with a small brass money plate reading '$20' and five empty hooks for the rings; the bid and pass buttons are two heavy brass paddles at the bottom edge. Deep shadow, a single chandelier, cigar haze. Text must be real, legible English exactly as listed.

moments.title: Auction room plate
moments.prompt: Repaint the reference image keeping its composition, camera, lighting, colours and materials exactly. Change only this: empty the room of every piece of interface, so it is the auction house alone - the dark wood panelling, the chandelier, the single spotlight beam falling on the centre of the red carpet, the two leather club chairs low left and right, the velvet rope, the cigar haze. The rostrum, the lectern, the player card, the gavel, the brass plates, the paddles, the hooks, the rings and every word and number are gone, and the centre of the floor is open and empty under the light. A clean background plate with no text anywhere.

The card table, the player cards, the scoreboard strip, the hanging sign, the rings, the hooks and every word and number are gone, and the middle of the floor is open and empty. moments.title: Campaign draft
moments.prompt: Redesign the game screen in the reference image. Keep its CONTENT and purpose exactly, in three columns: LEFT, the opponent - a header 'Level 5 opponent - Utah Jazz 26' with '22-60 season lines', a half-court diagram labelled 'Tactic: Horns' with five circles bearing initials (KG, KF, LM, BS, CW) and the names GEORGE, FILIPOWSKI, MARKKANEN, SENSABAUGH, WILLIAMS at their positions, and under it a five-row list of those players with their points, rebounds and assists. CENTRE, the spin - 'Spin 1 of 5 - it lands on', two reels, a TEAM reel showing 'Cleveland Cavaliers' between 'Dallas Mavericks' and 'Los Angeles Clippers' and a YEAR reel showing '2003' between '2002' and '2004', each with a HOLD toggle; below, the heading 'CLEVELAND CAVALIERS - 2003 - Eastern Conference - Central - 17-65' and a roster of eight rows (Ricky Davis 03, Zydrunas Ilgauskas 03, Dajuan Wagner 03, Carlos Boozer 03, Jumaine Jones 03, Darius Miles 03, Tyrone Hill 03, Milt Palacio 03) each with position, a role word and three numbers. RIGHT, my five - 'Gaziantep ag' with '91-17' and '0 of 5', a half-court with five dotted empty rings PG SG SF PF C each marked OPEN, and five lines 'Draft a man here'. One wide bar at the bottom reading 'Tap a player to scout him'. Change the DESIGN: this is a SCOUTING WAR ROOM late at night, filling the whole 16:9 frame. The left column is the opponent pinned to a cork-and-chalk wall - the court drawn in chalk, the five men as pinned photos with chalk initials, their stat lines on a clipped sheet. The centre is a tall brass-and-walnut slot machine standing on a long oak table: its two reels are the team and the year, lit from inside, with two brass HOLD levers; the roster is eight scouting dossiers laid in a row on the table below it, each a card with a name tab, the role stamped on it and its three numbers. The right column is my court as a floor diagram glowing on a light table, five empty rings lit as soft spotlights marked OPEN, with five empty name tags beside it. The bottom bar is a brass plate along the table edge. One hanging lamp over the table, haze, deep shadow at the edges. Text must be real, legible English exactly as listed.

moments.title: Campaign draft, no photos
moments.prompt: Repaint the reference image keeping its composition, layout, lighting, materials and every piece of text exactly. Change only this: the five pinned photographs of players on the left chalk wall are replaced by five pinned index cards of the same size, each a plain cream card with two large chalk-black initials (KG, KF, LM, BS, CW) and nothing else drawn on it - no photograph, no face, no figure anywhere on the screen. The names under the cards stay. Everything else is untouched: the chalk court, the stat sheet, the slot machine and its reels, the eight dossiers, the light-table court, the brass plate.
